hypotheses.title: Unified H29-HPVC + Walker Lane Anisotropic Seismic-Fabric Structure-Tensor Coherence (targeting the SE quadrant deficit)
layers: deq_n100a15 and ieq_n100a15 earthquake density rasters + geod_shearrate
H29-1 hydrothermal/piedmont/destriped-magnetic/Frangi-vesselness feature stack + weighted 300 m CELF cover
hypotheses.signature: Multi-scale structure-tensor anisotropy (lambda1 - lambda2)/(lambda1 + lambda2) of earthquake-density ridges (`ieq_n100a15`, `deq_n100a15`) aligned with dextral/transtensional `geod_shearrate` gradients in the Hawthorne/Tonopah Walker Lane belt, fused into the H29-S 2-stage vesselness + weighted CELF pipeline.
hypotheses.why_missing_faults: Active transtensional strands in the SE Mina deflection / Walker Lane rupture distributed stepover zones with strong microseismic lineament fabric despite discontinuous Holocene alluvial scarps.
hypotheses.confounders: Off-fault earthquake swarms, catalog-completeness gradients, and over-smoothed hypocenter kernels.
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: H29-1 beat D0 in NW (+0.0022), NE_LidarGap (+0.0024), and SW (+0.0032), losing only SE (-0.0025) because H29-1 omitted D0's `ieq/deq` structure-tensor coherence. Combining H29-S with multi-scale seismic-fabric coherence has never been run.

hypotheses.title: Andersonian 60-degree Hanging-Wall Dip-Offset Geophysical-to-Scarp Doublet Pairing
layers: Destriped rtp and iso_grav_anom horizontal-gradient crests
hypotheses.signature: Directed cross-correlation between a subtle surface break at (y, x) and a parallel magnetic/gravity/basement gradient crest shifted 200-700 m perpendicular to strike into the down-dropped hanging wall.
hypotheses.why_missing_faults: Eroded range-front and piedmont segments lose continuous surface scarp expression while the down-dip 60-deg basement step persists 300-600 m basinward.
hypotheses.confounders: Tilted stratiform volcanic hogbacks dipping toward valleys.
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: All prior repo features (H28-1, H28-3, H29-1) evaluate co-located (0 m) multi-field overlap, never directed cross-strike hanging-wall offset pairing.
hypotheses.data_gate: Existing hash-pinned raster bands; no external download needed.

hypotheses.title: Transverse Range-Front Canyon-Mouth Knickpoint & Alluvial-Fan Apex Collinearity
hypotheses.signature: Collinear 0.5-2 km alignments of steepened transverse stream-channel outlets and fan apexes along active footwall range fronts where Holocene debris-flow aggradation buries inter-canyon scarps.
hypotheses.why_missing_faults: Rapidly aggrading bajadas erase continuous surface scarps within centuries while preserving aligned canyon-mouth knickpoints.
hypotheses.confounders: Resistant stratiform bedrock hogbacks crossed by transverse streams.
